tg.name: S03v Cannobio Centro città - Cannobio bivio S03
tg.description: From Cannobio town center, near the Church of San Vittore and the bus stop, at the crossroads of S03 for Cannero and nearby crossroads S05 for Monte Carza.

tg.name: M39 - Folsogno - Bocchetta di Sant'Antonio
tg.description: Interesting and pleasant trip up to La Cailina from which it is possible make return with a circular route to Alpe Blizz and then following the M37, beyond it becomes very tiring and difficult to follow and intended for expert hikers
tg.note: Relation with photos (click on → Web site) mantained by CAI Sezioni Est Monterosa DB

tg.name: S01b Ponte Falmenta - Crealla
tg.description: From Ponte Falmenta (SP 75 Val Cannobina) you go down to the bridge over Cannobino torrent; few steps for the bridges over torrents Falmenta and Crealla and after the ascent of the "Rizzada",a famous mule track with 1500 steps,you reach Crealla.

tg.name: S00b - Lunecco - Bivio S00 (vicinanze Drignago)
tg.description: From Lunecco (SP 75 Val Cannobina) go up in the direction of Slina. At an altitude of about 510/520 m turn right in the direction of Cavaglio. Nearby of Drignago you cross the S00 route.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT

n: S00e Cursolo - Airetta - Ponte Teia - Gurro

tg.name: S00e Cursolo - Airetta - Ponte Teia - Gurro
tg.description: From Cursolo, at the crossroads of S00, descend to Airetta on the SS631 of the Val Cannobina; go along it for 6/700 m and descend to Ponte Teia on the Cannobino torrent; from here, passing next to Sasso Durone, you go up to Gurro at the crossroads of S01.

tg.name: S05 Cannobio - Monte Carza
tg.description: From Cannobio (Casali Bagnara) you go up to Piatè, you pass near a little lake and the source of Acqua Minerale. Subsequently to the Masarecci huts and the Pro Redond farm to then exit on the ridge at the crossroads with R40 for Monte Carza.
tg.from: Cannobio bivio S03 Casali Bagnara / al Roccolo (m 232)

tg.name: S07 Sant'Anna (Traffiume) - Pro Redond
tg.description: From the Orrido of S.Anna in Traffiume, after passing the SP 75, go up a steep mule track to I Pianoni, take the left and pass the Rio Barala, go up to Alpe Gallona and reach Pro Redond, a wonderful balcony overlooking the northern part of Lake Maggiore.
tg.from: Orrido e Chiesa di Sant'Anna bivio S00 (m 247)
tg.to: Pro Redond (Pra Rotondo) bivi S05 S05b (m 940)

tg.name: S01a Nivetta - Calachina
tg.description: From Nivetta (SP 75 Val Cannobina) go down to the bridge over the Cannobino torrent and then go up a steep path to Calachina.

n: S09 Bivio S11 sopra Socraggio - Bocchetta del Tondone

tg.name: S09 Bivio S11 sopra Socraggio - Bocchetta del Tondone
tg.description: From the crossroads of S11 above Socraggio go up to alp Piazzola and Aurasco; from here to the Monti Sommalemna (with S09a you reach the Monti Pianoni) and to the Bocchetta del Tondone.

tg.name: S09a Monti Sommalemna - Monti Pianoni
tg.description: From the Monti Sommalemna, at the crossroads with the S09, you reach I Pianoni passing through the mountain pastures of the Monti Nuvo, then connect with the S07.

tg.name: S11 Socraggio - Piazza S.Eurosia
tg.description: From Socraggio go up and pass west of Cima Tondone, you reach Alpe Graggio, Suria and then Piazza where there are the Oratory of Sant'Eurosia and a picnic area.

tg.name: S11a Aurasco - Alpe Graggio
tg.description: From Alpe Aurasco, at the crossroads with S09, you pass Cima Tondone around west and you reach Alpe Graggio at the crossroads with S11. From here you reach Piazza where the Oratory of Sant'Eurosia and a picnic area are located.

tg.name: S13 Luera - Archia
tg.description: From Luera at the crossroads with S01 go up to the huts of the mountain pastures of the Monti di Rodé, then to Cima Cerro to reach Alpe Archia at the crossroads with R20.

tg.name: S15 Crealla - Passo Folungo
tg.description: From Crealla, along the orographic left of the Rio Crealla, passing through Doro Sotto, Pianca, Lismaggio, Lavé, up to Passo Folungo.
tg.from: Crealla - bivio S01 S01b SI GTA (m 627)

n: X14 - Alpe Busarasca - Bocchetta di Campo

tg.name: X14 - Alpe Busarasca - Bocchetta di Campo
tg.description: A wild path in one of the most remote areas of Val Pogallo, following a non-existent track, looking for obligatory passages, walking on very steep meadows are a constant throughout the entire route
tg.note: ATTENTION extremely complex and tiring route, total lack of track and signs

tg.name: S01d Ponte Spoccia - Falmenta
tg.description: At Ponte Spoccia, on the Provincial Road 75 of the Valle Cannobina, go down for about 400 m until the crossroads for Solgia, pass through the hamlet of Solgia and la Valle to reach Falmenta.

tg.name: S02 Cannobio - San Bartolomeo Valmara
tg.description: From Cannobio to San Bartolomeo Valmara, walking first on the long lake of Lido di Cannobio and then on the "Via delle Genti" through Campeglio, Cinzago, San Bartolomeo in Montibus with its beautiful ancient church of Romanesque origin, Formine.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT
tg.from: Cannobio, bivio S00 Ponte Ballerino ( m 205)
tg.to: San Bartolomeo Valmara loc. Spasù SS 34 (m 220) )

n: S02a Cannobio Lignago - bivio S02 Darbedo/Campeglio

tg.name: S02a Cannobio Lignago - bivio S02 Darbedo/Campeglio
tg.description: Section of the "Via delle Genti" between the S02 crossroads at Casali Lignago and the S02 crossroads on the climb between Casali Darbedo and Campeglio, hamlets of Cannobio.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT
tg.from: Cannobio, bivio S02 Casali Lignago ( m 205)
tg.to: Bivio S02 salita Casali Darbedo - Campeglio di Cannobio (m 315)

tg.name: S02b Cannobio Lignago - Sant'Agata - Campeglio
tg.description: From Cannobio to Sant'Agata, "balcony of Lake Maggiore", passing through Gerbia and I Ronchi, through woods and terraces, to the crossroads of S02 in Campeglio.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT
tg.from: Bivio S02a Casali Lignago / Casali Lignago al Ronco (m 210)

tg.name: S02c Campeglio - Ronco - Formine
tg.description: From Campeglio to Formine passing through Ronco. At the crossroads with S02e, route for Marchile and Rondonico, the connection for San Bartolomeo in Montibus.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT

tg.name: S02e Rondonico - Marchile bivio S02c
tg.description: From Rondonico on the SS 34 of Lake Maggiore go up to Marchile and at the crossroads with the S02c route. From here also the connection path with San Bartolomeo in Montibus.

tg.name: S01f Creves - Provola
tg.description: From Creves we cross the Torrente Cannobio and go up to Provola where we connects with the S01 route.

n: S10 Cavaglio - Le Biuse - Monte Limidario

tg.name: S10 Cavaglio - Le Biuse - Monte Limidario
tg.description: A long and demanding route that leads from Cavaglio to the panoramic peak of Monte Limidario through the wonderful mountain pasture of Monti Olzeno, Le Biuse with the Rifugio delle Nevi, Tre Confini, Catta Margugna and the bivouac of Alpe Quadra.

n: S10e Gurrone - Bivio S10 a La Piazza

tg.name: S10e Gurrone - Bivio S10 a La Piazza
tg.description: Connection route between Gurrone and the S10 route near La Piazza between Cavaglio and Monti Olzeno.

n: S10a Sorgente del Fornale - Bocchetta del Fornale

tg.name: S10a Sorgente del Fornale - Bocchetta del Fornale
tg.description: From the crossroads of S10 to the Sorgente del Fornale to the Bocchetta del Fornale on the Swiss border.

tg.name: S12 Orasso - Bugnago - Spoccia
tg.description: High route between Orasso and Spoccia through the terraces and high mountain pastures of the two villages: Bugnago, Ghilone, Niva and Cheibi (Monti Ghebbio).

n: S10b Spoccia bivio S12 - Catta Margugna

tg.name: S10b Spoccia bivio S12 - Catta Margugna
tg.description: From Spoccia to Catta Margugna, a complex route with long sections on very exposed slopes, section on ledge with the presence of chains, steep sections difficult with holes and stones between shrubs and rhododendrons.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC

tg.name: S06 Sant'Agata - Faierone - Monte Limidario
tg.description: Demanding route from Sant'Agata to the top of the Limidario. After the pastures of Monti Marcalone, Rombiago and Scierz, the route go up entirely on a long and panoramic ridge that runs through the Monte Faierone, Punta Fonzina and the Cruit.

n: S04 Bivio S02 S.Bartolomeo in Montibus - Monte Faierone

tg.name: S04 Bivio S02 S.Bartolomeo in Montibus - Monte Faierone
tg.description: From the crossroads of S02 between San Bartolomeo in Montibus and Formine, climb to the meadows of L'Agher (Prati d'Agro), a wonderful balcony on Lake Maggiore, and then climb up to the north summit of Monte Faierone via its eastern ridge.
tg.from: Bivio S02 vicino a San Bartolomeo in Montibus (m 525)
tg.to: Monte Faierone cima nord bivio S06 (m 1715)

tg.name: S08 Cavaglio - Monte Giove
tg.description: From Cavaglio San Donnino go along the Rio Cavaglio valley and cross it on the Ganna bridge, go up to the mountain pastures Cruscina and Biessen to reach Alpe Rombiago (Baita degli Zabò refuge) and from here to the nearby top of the Monte Giove.

n: S08a Monti Biessen - Bivio S06 Alpe Scesel

tg.name: S08a Monti Biessen - Bivio S06 Alpe Scesel
tg.description: Halfway connection between the S08 route at Monti Biessen and the S06 route near the Alpe Scesel which go up at west of Sant'Agata.

tg.name: S14 Orasso - Alpe Pluni
tg.description: From Orasso to Alpe Pluni (Polunia) passing through Monte Vecchio and crossing the pass at the southwestern slopes of Monte Torriggia. Refuge in Monte Vecchio and bivouac at Alpe Pluni.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC

tg.name: S16 Cursolo - Alpe Pluni
tg.description: From Cursolo to Alpe Pluni passing through the Monti Pratini and Monti of Cursolo, then bypassing the Costa Torriggia to go up to the crossroads with the route S14 just before the Alpe Pluni bivouac.

tg.name: S16a Cursolo - Monte Vecchio
tg.description: Connection path between Cursolo and Monte Vecchio, between routes S16 and S14.

n: S14b Bivio S14 Sasso Vecchio - Monte Torriggia

tg.name: S14b Bivio S14 Sasso Vecchio - Monte Torriggia
tg.description: From the saddle of Sasso Vecchio (Costa Torriggia) a steep ridge path that from south-west climbs to Monte Torriggia.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC
tg.symbol: Signposted at the beginning of the climb, then evident route on the ridge.

n: S10c Spoccia bivio S10d (S12) - Cappella di Lego - Tre Confini

tg.name: S10c Spoccia bivio S10d (S12) - Cappella di Lego - Tre Confini
tg.description: From Spoccia, from the crossroads with the S10d route (near the church also the crossroads with S12), to Tre Confini, the crossroads of S10 and S10d, passing through Alpe Marano and Cappella di Lego.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC

n: R19a Rifugio Pian Vadà - Cresta est Monte Vadà

tg.name: R19a Rifugio Pian Vadà - Cresta est Monte Vadà
tg.description: Direct route connecting the Pian Vadà refuge (bivouac) to the eastern ridge of Monte Vadà at the crossroads with the R19 and S17. The path crosses a long steep slope with large tufts of grass.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC
tg.from: Rifugio Bivacco Pian Vadà bivio R20 (m 1711)
tg.to: Cresta est Monte Vadà bivio R19 S17 (m 1750)

n: S19 Falmenta - Alpe Fornà - Piè di Zeda

tg.name: S19 Falmenta - Alpe Fornà - Piè di Zeda
tg.description: From Falmenta to Alpe Fornà and Piè Zeda going up the Scalinata.Halfway traverse up to the Rio Falmenta, then steep climb in an alpine environment. At Fornà the refuge dedicated to the partisan U.Cavallasca Cucciolo and memorial of the shooting of '44.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC

n: S17 Falmenta - Cresta est Monte Vadà bivio R19

tg.name: S17 Falmenta - Cresta est Monte Vadà bivio R19
tg.description: From Falmenta go down on asphalted road to the bridge over the Falmenta stream, after the path go up to the right to the Monti Barro and Ortighedo, then always on the N-E ridge of Monte Vadà and with a traverse reach the crossroads R19 on the east ridge.
tg.note: Report maintained by path detectors CAI SOSEC Piemonte - MT RC
tg.to: Cresta est Monte Vadà bivio R19 R19a (m 1750)
